evidence.quote: InfoQ Homepage News AI Is Amplifying Software Engineering Performance, Says The 2025 DORA Report
The 2025 DevOps Research and Assessment (DORA) report, titled State of AI-Assisted Software Development, finds that AI does not automatically improve software delivery performance.
The research draws on survey responses from nearly 5,000 technology professionals and more than 100 hours of qualitative interviews.
This dynamic may increase the likelihood of defects, deployment failures, or operational instability if not properly managed.

Organizations with mature DevOps practices, well-defined development workflows, and strong platform capabilities are far more likely to convert AI-driven productivity gains into measurable improvements in delivery performance.
